posts.title: Verifying mikrotik's ssh host key
posts.description: Mikrotik’s RouterOS only supported RSA SSH keys for a long time, however modern firmware versions do support ed25519 keys. I decided to upgrade the old rsa key to a newer ed25519 one. After that, connecting via ssh obviously displayed a warning to verify the server’s host key: $ ssh -T mkrouter The authenticity of host '[192.168.1.1]:2345 ([192.168.1.1]:2345)' can ' t be established. posts.title: Opening CT scan from Ez3D Plus in Romexis Viewer
posts.description: I’ve had 2 dental CT scans recently, from different scanner manufacturers and with the results opening in 2 different programs. One was Romexis Viewer and the other was Ez3D Plus. Planmeca Romexis Viewer (I have 5.2.1.R) is better because it has a native macos version, available on the flash drive with the scan results and windows version.
